purpose: Equity exit proceeds after a liquidation-preference waterfall, ported from ApexLogics Apex #141 (AL-148). From the exit valuation, the aggregate preferred investment, the preferred ownership fraction and liquidation-preference multiple, the participation type (non/full/capped with a cap multiple), and your role, ownership, option strike and cost basis, the node walks the waterfall layer by layer: the preference is min(exit, invested × multiple); non-participating preferred converts to common only when its pro-rata share strictly exceeds the preference (NVCA convention, strict inequality); full participating takes the preference then shares pro-rata; capped participating takes the preference plus pro-rata participation floored at 0 and capped at cap × invested, with the excess reverting to the common pool. Your gross proceeds follow your role (preferred shares in the preferred total; common takes the declared fraction of the common pool), net proceeds are floored at 0 after the option strike, taxable gain is max(0, net − basis) per IRC §1001, and the break-even exit (0 for the preferred role, per Apex) is preference + strike / (common share of common). Non-finite inputs are refused with REFUSED_NON_FINITE_INPUT per the I-JSON guard and a non-positive exit with REFUSED_NON_POSITIVE_EXIT, never a silent guess. The preferred-captured-more-than-common warning is Apex #141's own heuristic, carried flagged (ART754_PREF_WINS_WARNING_HEURISTIC); no official threshold exists for it.
